data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek word 'νόος' (nóos), meaning 'mind' or 'grace'. Noni is a name of Greek origin, often used in Christian traditions for girls, symbolizing the divine grace bestowed upon them. The name Noni carries the meaning “Grace” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Noni usually hope their child will grow to embody grace and live with faith, good character and purpose.
